_about: BD-1077 (docs/193 s5): every full-round shape in src/ that is round ON PURPOSE (button, bar, dot, circle, panel, art, effect, key). A TAG is never listed here: it uses src/shared/ChipStyle.luau. tools/verify_chip_style.py fails on a round shape that is not listed here and on a line here that matches no code. 'contains' is a piece of the source line; 'count' is how many lines it must match when more than one.

a big 22 px plate corner on a large panel, not a tag (Bootstrap is not changed by this task)
